scope: MVP10.1 source inventory, amended through MVP10.3b.2 snapshot/filter selection. Configuration, authoring and selection adoption is recorded per owner/contract; paths/rendering, generic record publication/reads, external operations and universal route parity remain pending. Aliases share canonical owners; source coverage is not diagnostic completion.

constants.failures: No operation on reading a constant; package import can fail on an invalid storage-root selector.
constants.translation_owner: Storage/config resolver at import or first operation; no exception wrapper around constants.
constants.desired_diagnostic: Identify AUTOSLURM_STORAGE_ROOT and the invalid value, rather than blaming the requested job.
constants.next_action: Correct the explicit storage selector; do not choose another lane.
constants.adoption: pending; referenced suites cover existing behavior, not the future diagnostic contract

storage.failures: Invalid/relative/empty root, expansion/resolution failure, denied directory creation, partial directory creation.
storage.translation_owner: storage path validation and directory creation; errors.py holds facts, not filesystem operations.
storage.desired_diagnostic: Setting and attempted local path, errno and which directories already exist.
storage.next_action: Correct the selected root/permissions explicitly; preserve existing records.
storage.adoption: pending; referenced suites cover existing behavior, not the future diagnostic contract

config.failures: Absent/unreadable/corrupt config, invalid profile/root/alias/account, missing selected machine or activation, failed atomic publication.
config.translation_owner: config normalization/selection/read/write, with presentation at config CLI.
config.desired_diagnostic: Config path, selected machine, setting and cause; distinguish missing/corrupt/denied and publication phase.
config.next_action: Edit the identified setting in the selected storage lane; never replace unreadable config with a fresh one implicitly.
config.adoption: MVP10.3a: ConfigurationError carries configuration_invalid/resource_missing/resource_inaccessible/record_invalid, actual source path, machine/field/cause and config_write=not_started for known read/validation failures. CLI root/alias/standalone renders shared text/exit/debug; unreadable/corrupt existing entries never trigger first-use setup. Atomic publication/storage-root selection and post-save external validation diagnostics remain pending; no new record schema. MVP10.3b.2 validates bundle_filter_mode through one config owner; absence alone defaults reads to active, while invalid/unreadable/corrupt configuration is visible.

authoring.failures: Invalid declarations, unknown/missing/duplicate options, types/ranges/nonfinite values, unsafe tokens, command/path-role mismatch.
authoring.translation_owner: CommandOption/CommandContract and argument_compilation validation, retaining option/job context.
authoring.desired_diagnostic: Exact field/job/option and expected versus supplied type/constraint, without importing or executing job code.
authoring.next_action: Correct the named declaration/setting; revalidate the exact saved job with its trusted contract before saving.
authoring.adoption: Known command/option/argument guards use InvalidRequestError with field/option/job/command context, explicit native causes and no inferred effects. Saved job validation retains explicit settings. Raw dictionaries still need trusted client signature validation. MVP10.3b.3 adopts known path/render guards with named job/machine/field, safe syntax evidence and exact bundle context; external readiness remains 10.4.

typer.failures: Missing optional Typer, unsupported version/app/metadata/type/parser behavior, discovery failure.
typer.translation_owner: typer_adapter capability checks; no callback execution or dynamic import by name.
typer.desired_diagnostic: Adapter capability/option and installed versus supported version; chain parser-discovery exceptions.
typer.next_action: Use supported static declarations or manual CommandContract; installation is an explicit authoring-environment action.
typer.adoption: Explicit adapter capability guards use InvalidRequestError and field/option/stage; missing optional import retains native and diagnostic cause. Unsupported versions retain installed/supported numbers in wording. Unanticipated discovery/programming failures propagate, never arbitrary ValueError translation or callback execution.

graph.failures: Malformed job/graph, unknown dependency, name mismatch, cycle, missing script/job ID mapping.
graph.translation_owner: job_dependency validation and bulk_submit topological/callback boundaries.
graph.desired_diagnostic: Named job/dependency or missing mapping; distinguish invalid graph before dispatch from missing response after callback.
graph.next_action: Correct the graph before submission; after any callback, inspect accepted/unknown outcomes before retrying.
graph.adoption: dependency_graph validates container/job/dependency shapes and names, then rejects cycles with a chained CycleError and shared diagnosis. Parent-to-children result unchanged. Lower-level bulk_submit callback/ID mapping and post-dispatch evidence remain MVP10.5.

persistence.failures: Missing/unreadable/corrupt bundle, invalid names/shapes/graph, JSON serialization, collision and publication failures.
persistence.translation_owner: save_load_jobs and record_files, not blanket CLI catches.
persistence.desired_diagnostic: Exact bundle path/field and publication phase; serialization and permissions distinct; note any existing published snapshot.
persistence.next_action: Repair input/access explicitly; inspect exact path if publication may have happened before retrying save/append.
persistence.adoption: Partial: authoring input guards adopted in b.1; name selection now raises SelectionError and internal snapshot/append creation falls back only after resource_missing. Direct loader JSON/I/O/publication and phase effects remain MVP10.3c. MVP10.3b.3 renders direct scripts before opening/truncating destinations; publication failures/atomic replacement still 3c. MVP10.3c split before implementation: c.1 shared writer implemented with RecordWriteError/effect-aware cleanup; c.2 domain reads/enrichment/CLI and c.3 receipt/cache/script persistence remain open.

selection.failures: Invalid/conflicting selector/date/index, missing exact file, broken payload, directory access and malformed filter config.
selection.translation_owner: bundle_selection discovery/selection; bad entries need per-item facts, not an empty listing.
selection.desired_diagnostic: Exact selector and storage root, broken-entry evidence, empty versus unavailable listing; retain filename-only selection policy.
selection.next_action: Select a listed exact snapshot; repair unreadable records/config without deleting historical evidence.
selection.adoption: Known selection/discovery failures use SelectionError with selection operation and invalid_argument/resource_missing/resource_inaccessible/record_invalid codes. A missing selection replaces FileNotFoundError explicitly at this dev boundary. Per-entry state/plain diagnostic preserves healthy neighbours; unknown jobs/counts are None, not empty/zero. File/nearest selection remains payload-free. Bad filter config never defaults silently. No source fallback, implicit directory creation, deletion, scheduler query or retry.

paths.failures: Invalid base/traversal/absolute logical path, overlapping path roles, absent recorded paths, bad producing identity; remote readiness may fail.
paths.translation_owner: ExecutionContext for pure resolution; execution adapter for existence checks; transport for discovery.
paths.desired_diagnostic: Logical and attempted resolved path, selected/producing machine, field and check; transport failure is not FileNotFound.
paths.next_action: Fix the selected profile/logical path or verify access explicitly; never discover a replacement machine for historical jobs.
paths.adoption: MVP10.3b.3: InvalidRequestError for pure path roles/base/traversal/cwd/log and render guards; machine/job/field/option/logical/attempted resolved context where known. Saved context lookup uses SelectionError for absent/ambiguous/invalid evidence and validates producing roots/transport without current-profile discovery. Historical roots/transport retained. Existence/root-discovery adapters and observation-side producing_machine remain separately planned; no blanket effect inference.

transport.failures: Process launch/permission, SSH nonzero/timeout/interruption, malformed helper/root response, unavailable configured interpreter.
transport.translation_owner: transport/run_slurm session/probe adapters with operation/stage supplied by caller.
transport.desired_diagnostic: Alias, executable/helper/path, return code or errno, bounded safe detail; do not infer password/2FA diagnosis from generic SSH failure.
transport.next_action: Verify operator-owned SSH/profile/helper explicitly; no alternate host/local fallback, key handling or automatic action retry.
transport.adoption: pending; referenced suites cover existing behavior, not the future diagnostic contract

transfer.failures: Remote mkdir failure, missing source, scp/rsync launch/nonzero/interruption, partial transfer and local target creation.
transfer.translation_owner: file_transfer adapters, with per-target progress passed to sync/submission coordinator.
transfer.desired_diagnostic: Selected machine/source/target, transfer phase and known/unknown copied files; bounded safe command detail.
transfer.next_action: Inspect destination/receipt before retrying staging; scientific datasets are outside log retrieval.
transfer.adoption: pending; referenced suites cover existing behavior, not the future diagnostic contract

submission.failures: Invalid request/preflight, staging/session failure, scheduler rejection, malformed accepted-ID response, lost dispatch response, tracking publication/cleanup failure, interrupts.
submission.translation_owner: submission_operation + bulk_submit_driver side-effect boundaries; keep SubmissionError.receipt and original cause.
submission.desired_diagnostic: Receipt/reference, accepted IDs, failed/unattempted/unknown jobs, dispatched phase and secondary tracking/cleanup errors.
submission.next_action: Retain exact receipt and inspect/refresh it; never rerun an uncertain submission automatically.
submission.adoption: pending; referenced suites cover existing behavior, not the future diagnostic contract

receipt.failures: Absent/corrupt/incompatible receipt, identity mismatch, failed remote refresh, failed local projection/publication.
receipt.translation_owner: submission validation/refresh and record_files; preserve primary evidence before translating.
receipt.desired_diagnostic: Exact receipt path/identity, safe cause, original jobs/IDs and observation/tracking errors; no invented rejection.
receipt.next_action: Inspect exact local/remote receipt read-only; preserve known IDs, no automatic resubmission.
receipt.adoption: pending; referenced suites cover existing behavior, not the future diagnostic contract

inspection.failures: Invalid selectors/bounds, corrupt/changed bundle or receipt, unavailable profiles/scheduler, malformed response, missing/unreadable/changing logs, denied/corrupt cache.
inspection.translation_owner: inspection_collection/scheduler/log_files/cache adapters return facts; projection preserves per-item/freshness semantics.
inspection.desired_diagnostic: Operation errors versus broken item, absent/empty/not_cached/stale/failed/unknown; include timestamps, bounds and retained good evidence.
inspection.next_action: Use exact run/job/task and bounded logs; explicitly refresh unavailable/stale evidence; failed science is a successful observation, not an inspection exception.
inspection.adoption: pending; referenced suites cover existing behavior, not the future diagnostic contract

software_intent.failures: Invalid historical manifest shape/version/name/revision/repository/subdirectory, differing job intents.
software_intent.translation_owner: software_manifest pure validation; do not revive deployment/release machinery.
software_intent.desired_diagnostic: Job/project/field and invalid request; redact credentials before serializing rejected repository values.
software_intent.next_action: Correct retained metadata or use operator-prepared environment; this API does not clone/install/select a runtime.
software_intent.adoption: Known pure historical-intent validation uses InvalidRequestError with field/project/job when known. Repository parser failures retain native cause and generic safe diagnostic detail, excluding raw rejected addresses. No deployment machinery or automatic runtime selection.

software_status.failures: Invalid project/root/requirements/limits, unreadable declarations, unavailable Git/interpreter, malformed/nonzero/timed-out probe, version or commit mismatch.
software_status.translation_owner: software_requirements local readers and software_status/environment probe adapters.
software_status.desired_diagnostic: Selected machine/project, expected and observed identity/dependency, warnings and unknown checks; mismatch is a result requiring attention, not necessarily a failed request.
software_status.next_action: Inspect the named project/environment and update explicitly; never install machine dependencies to make comparison pass.
software_status.adoption: pending; referenced suites cover existing behavior, not the future diagnostic contract

software_update.failures: Missing/nonexecutable/wrong-prefix venv Python, missing/dirty checkout/upstream/Git, preflight timeout; pull/install failure/interruption/lost response.
software_update.translation_owner: software_update_probe returns stdlib facts; software_update translates and retains SoftwareUpdateError.evidence and chained cause.
software_update.desired_diagnostic: Attempted configured Python/setting/alias, stage, errno/returncode and safe bounded detail; before/after commit and installation state; unknown only after possible action.
software_update.next_action: Fix the identified profile/preflight failure; if pull/install may have started inspect checkout/environment before any explicit retry. No reset/reclone/extra environment.
software_update.adoption: pending; referenced suites cover existing behavior, not the future diagnostic contract

context.failures: Missing/unreadable packaged or checkout guidance, unmatched selectors, unavailable action metadata, bad exact job/task selector.
context.translation_owner: context resource reader and experiment_context facade; route runtime reads through inspection.
context.desired_diagnostic: Recipe/section/run/job/task identity; distinguish no match from unavailable files and preserve underlying inspection evidence.
context.next_action: Use the installed recipe/listed sections or exact run; do not substitute another machine/job.
context.adoption: pending; referenced suites cover existing behavior, not the future diagnostic contract

cancel.failures: Invalid selection/config, unavailable status, scancel launch/nonzero/lost response; earlier target requests may already be accepted.
cancel.translation_owner: cancel selection + local/SSH cancellation adapters; coordinator accumulates per-target effects.
cancel.desired_diagnostic: Exact producing machine/IDs, preview versus request acceptance versus observed terminal cancellation; retain successful and unknown targets.
cancel.next_action: Inspect affected IDs before any further cancellation; unavailable state must not become safe-to-delete evidence.
cancel.adoption: pending; referenced suites cover existing behavior, not the future diagnostic contract

clean.failures: Invalid selector, broken/unreadable or changed snapshot, unavailable status, denied unlink, partial deletion.
clean.translation_owner: clean preview/selection and per-file deletion boundary; retain conservative receipt protection.
clean.desired_diagnostic: Exact files retained/deleted/failed/unknown, selection evidence and errors even when other items succeed.
clean.next_action: Review fresh preview and retained submission evidence; no automatic deletion/retry of uncertain files.
clean.adoption: pending; referenced suites cover existing behavior, not the future diagnostic contract

sync.failures: Config/discovery errors, absent source directory versus failed SSH test, denied local target/rsync, earlier directories partially copied.
sync.desired_diagnostic: Per-directory source/destination, missing/failed/partial states and completed copies; preserve producing paths.
sync.next_action: Inspect local mirror and retry an explicitly selected sync only after resolving access; no submission or scientific-result interpretation.
sync.adoption: pending; referenced suites cover existing behavior, not the future diagnostic contract

discovery.failures: Missing repository/pyproject, invalid TOML/catalog, unreadable/syntactically invalid source summary, failed catalog save.
discovery.translation_owner: apps.scan static readers + catalog publication; no importing discovered application code.
discovery.desired_diagnostic: Exact repository/catalog path, bad entry and read/parse/write phase; preserve existing valid catalog if another scan fails.
discovery.next_action: Correct path/metadata or explicitly rebuild catalog; do not treat unreadable catalog as empty then overwrite it.
discovery.adoption: pending; referenced suites cover existing behavior, not the future diagnostic contract

cli.failures: Usage/selector errors; inherited operation diagnostics; JSON serialization/terminal/clipboard failures; unexpected bugs.
cli.translation_owner: Thin apps/error_output presentation adapter (proposed), domain owner retains effects; root only dispatches.
cli.desired_diagnostic: Render expected diagnostic once, stable JSON envelope and explicit exit policy; retain evidence and chained/debug-visible unexpected bugs.
cli.next_action: Follow the underlying operation next action; a clipboard/printing failure does not authorize repeating side effects.
cli.adoption: Partial through b.2: selection/configuration errors at filter/submit/status/inspect/logs roots/aliases/standalone use the shared adapter and --debug; existing status/inspect/logs JSON modes use its envelope. Parser usage stays exit2. Other observation, presentation and post-dispatch policies remain MVP10.8/later domain slices.

acp.failures: Malformed request, missing/unknown action/parameters, underlying domain errors, unavailable metadata, unexpected bugs.
acp.translation_owner: acp dispatch validates envelope; domain operation supplies diagnostic/evidence; errors module never dispatches.
acp.desired_diagnostic: Equivalent Python/CLI diagnostic plus per-item result/receipt; top-level success means request completed, not science succeeded.
acp.next_action: Correct action/fields or follow the domain action; inspect partial/unknown evidence instead of replaying schedule/refresh.
acp.adoption: Partial b.2: expected SelectionError/ConfigurationError envelopes include shared diagnostic; list_experiments/list_runs retain per-entry state/diagnostic. SubmissionError receipt retention unchanged; other broad ACP handling and request validation remain MVP10.8.

diagnostics.failures: Invalid codes/context/cause/effect/secondary facts raise programming TypeError/ValueError; unknown/legacy errors are deliberately re-raised; terminal write failure re-raises initiating error.
diagnostics.translation_owner: errors owns facts/catalogue/safe serialization; apps.error_output owns presentation and opt-in exit only. Neither classifies scheduler effects or performs recovery.
diagnostics.desired_diagnostic: Immutable plain facts with bounded/redacted output, detached JSON, original exception chains, known/unknown caller-supplied effects and primary plus secondary evidence.
diagnostics.next_action: Call at an explicitly adopted boundary; preserve receipt/update evidence before presentation, and keep legacy handling when diagnostic is absent. No retry inference.
diagnostics.adoption: MVP10.2 foundation; MVP10.3a ConfigurationError/configuration_failure; MVP10.3b.1 InvalidRequestError and optional explicit cause/effects on invalid_argument. Identity enrichment compares against the same bounded/redacted representation. Other domains and universal CLI/ACP parity remain pending. MVP10.3b.2 adds SelectionError/selection_failure using existing catalogue codes and no inferred effects.

record_publication.failures: Serialization, directory/temp creation, flush/close, publication syscall, directory durability and cleanup failures, including an initiating interrupt/bug.
record_publication.translation_owner: record_files.atomic_json owns filesystem phase/effects; errors owns RecordWriteError/RecordCollisionError/record_write_failure. Callers retain domain evidence.
record_publication.desired_diagnostic: Exact destination/stage, native safe kind/errno, publication not_started/unknown/succeeded separate from durability, bounded secondary cleanup facts.
record_publication.next_action: Inspect exact destination and retained effects before repeating save/append; no blanket rollback or scheduler conclusion.
record_publication.adoption: MVP10.3c.1 implemented: typed OSError-compatible writer failures; serialization replaces raw TypeError/ValueError explicitly. Exclusive collisions remain FileExistsError-compatible; only clean collisions may select another snapshot timestamp. Native bugs/interrupts propagate; cleanup evidence cannot erase primary or original cause. Domain reads/enrichment/CLI and receipt/cache/script policies remain c.2/c.3/10.5/10.6.

autoslurm.acp.action_definitions.current: Live metadata dict; load exceptions earlier silently set empty dict.
autoslurm.acp.action_definitions.effects: Metadata read at package import, not remote.

autoslurm.acp.execute_acp.inputs: Request mapping with action and action-specific fields.
autoslurm.acp.execute_acp.current: success/result or error/message; expected SelectionError/ConfigurationError add diagnostic. Per-entry failed discovery remains in successful listings. SubmissionError result retains receipt. Other Exception still becomes a string and nonmapping input can fail before catch (MVP10.8 pending).
autoslurm.acp.execute_acp.effects: Action-dependent reads, local scheduling or receipt/cache refresh writes; no submit action.

autoslurm.acp.list_bundles.current: JSON-friendly identity/jobs/state/diagnostic rows; unknown jobs=None rather than empty. Expected selection/discovery errors retain typed diagnosis through dispatch.
autoslurm.acp.list_bundles.effects: Local reads only; no directory creation.

autoslurm.apps.agent_context.main.current: Empty help0; prints selected context; missing match empty success; unreadable resource raw OSError.

autoslurm.apps.bulk_submit_driver.main.inputs: Internal --capabilities, JSON stdin/file and storage/receipt protocol.
autoslurm.apps.bulk_submit_driver.main.current: JSON ok/result/receipt on expected protocol path; broad Exception -> ok false/error/optional receipt exit1; KeyboardInterrupt can escape.
autoslurm.apps.bulk_submit_driver.main.effects: Capabilities read-only; execution may claim/persist/submit. Human CLI envelope must not replace helper wire protocol.

autoslurm.apps.cancel.main.current: Default preview; raw selection/command errors; successful scancel prints Cancelled though only request acceptance known.
autoslurm.apps.cancel.main.effects: Queries during preview; --yes scancel per group, earlier groups may succeed before later failure. Current named profile is used for dispatch.

autoslurm.apps.clean.main.current: Default preview; broad load exceptions skip entries; raw unlink errors can follow earlier deletions. Unknown submitted counts no longer qualify for automatic stale/unsubmitted cleanup; explicit operator targets retain existing behavior.
autoslurm.apps.clean.main.effects: May query status even during preview; --yes deletes per path. Receipt-bearing/unreadable candidates conservatively retained.

autoslurm.apps.config.main.inputs: view/summary; settings update; set-default; interactive editor. Interactive env_command prompt supports add/replace/keep/clear.
autoslurm.apps.config.main.current: Empty/debug-only invocation shows help. Known ConfigurationError renders shared stderr diagnostic/exit 1 across root/alias/standalone; --debug re-raises original chain. Parser usage remains exit 2; unexpected bugs propagate. --view retains raw JSON output shape.
autoslurm.apps.config.main.effects: View/read local-only; true missing config may enter first-use editor. Unreadable/corrupt/invalid/dangling or concurrently present entries stop without reset/write. Valid saves still use atomic publication, and optional existing validation may SSH (mocked in task tests). Publication diagnostics pending.

autoslurm.apps.filter.main.current: Shared text/exit1 for known config/selection failures; --debug re-raises. Invalid parser choice exit2; publication errors retain old policy.
autoslurm.apps.filter.main.effects: Read is local with absence-only default; explicit mode writes config.

autoslurm.apps.initialize.main.current: Empty help0; save_bundle({},name), raw save errors.

autoslurm.apps.inspect.main.inputs: Names/indices or file, status/script/log/task options; optional clipboard/JSON. --debug for adopted selection/config errors.
autoslurm.apps.inspect.main.current: Views or legacy text; failures inconsistently raw; bad per-item view generally exit0; clipboard failure after successful print can raise. MVP10.3b.2 renders SelectionError/ConfigurationError through shared text/JSON/exit1/debug; no universal migration of returned observation/log errors or later legacy catches.
autoslurm.apps.inspect.main.effects: Observation/cache effects; requested clipboard writes are secondary presentation effect.

autoslurm.apps.logs.main.inputs: Status-like bundle/job/task selectors, stream, tail/bytes/files, cached/JSON. --debug for adopted selection/config errors.
autoslurm.apps.logs.main.current: Expected selection/read errors printed then exit1; error-view entries also exit1; healthy/empty/missing logs distinguishable. MVP10.3b.2 renders SelectionError/ConfigurationError through shared text/JSON/exit1/debug; no universal migration of returned observation/log errors or later legacy catches.
autoslurm.apps.logs.main.effects: Bounded log/status reads; refresh caches; no dataset retrieval.

autoslurm.apps.root.main.current: Empty/help prints help exit0; unknown action parser exit2; domain handler SystemExit/raw errors propagate.
autoslurm.apps.root.main.effects: Dispatch only; no global error catch or replay.

autoslurm.apps.scan.main.current: Argparse exit2 missing repo; scan table or raw parse/read/write errors; no registered catalog-list mode.
autoslurm.apps.scan.main.effects: Static AST/pyproject scan writes catalog via direct write_text; unreadable/corrupt catalog currently replaced with empty then saved.

autoslurm.apps.schedule.main.inputs: Script, Slurm options, application arguments, optional append/submit.
autoslurm.apps.schedule.main.current: Parses help text by executing script --help; adopted authoring InvalidRequestError renders shared stderr/exit 1, --autoslurm-debug re-raises original. Application --debug still forwards. Raw help-process/publication/other service failures remain; save can precede optional submit failure.
autoslurm.apps.schedule.main.effects: Application --help is executed (unlike typed adapter); bundle write precedes optional dispatch.

autoslurm.apps.software.main.current: Status errors -> unavailable JSON/text exit1; compatibility concern also exit1. Update SoftwareUpdateError evidence retained exit1; generic errors use different failed envelope. Empty/incomplete command help exit0.
autoslurm.apps.software.main.effects: status read-only probes; update pull+editable install. Neither changes machine scientific dependencies.

autoslurm.apps.status.main.inputs: Names/indices/date or exact bundle-file; array and cached/JSON options. --debug for adopted selection/config errors.
autoslurm.apps.status.main.current: Views text/JSON; broken/partial evidence normally exit0, raw selection/read failures can traceback; post-inspect bundle reload can fail. MVP10.3b.2 renders SelectionError/ConfigurationError through shared text/JSON/exit1/debug; no universal migration of returned observation/log errors or later legacy catches.
autoslurm.apps.status.main.effects: Fresh scheduler queries/cache; --cached no scheduler; snapshot listing no longer creates dirs.

autoslurm.apps.submission.main.inputs: Exact receipt or list filter; optional --refresh/--json.
autoslurm.apps.submission.main.current: Only SubmissionError caught, receipt printed then exit1; missing/corrupt read/list can traceback; parser misuse exit2.
autoslurm.apps.submission.main.effects: List/read local; refresh remote read plus local projection/receipt writes.

autoslurm.apps.submit.main.inputs: Name/date or file/latest/index plus machine overrides.
autoslurm.apps.submit.main.current: Strict selected-record gate before machine selection. Shared stderr/exit1/debug for adopted SelectionError/ConfigurationError/InvalidRequestError, including path/render preparation. Other legacy post-dispatch exception policy remains staged.
autoslurm.apps.submit.main.effects: Preview/selection reads then submission; accepted receipt must survive rendering error.

autoslurm.apps.sync.main.current: Delegates sync_machine; raw failures, no structured per-directory result.
autoslurm.apps.sync.main.effects: Empty argv starts default sync, does not just print help; partial copies possible.

autoslurm.bundle_selection.bundle_snapsh.inputs: Optional reference date for relevant listings; selected root/filter.
autoslurm.bundle_selection.bundle_snapsh.current: Metadata rows with state and diagnostic=None or plain diagnostic facts; healthy entries retained beside broken/unavailable/missing entries. Unknown contents/counts None; graph-invalid dictionaries retain observed names/counts. Invalid filename discovery candidates still ignored; newer failures remain visible beside history.
autoslurm.bundle_selection.bundle_snapsh.effects: Local enumeration/reads only; does not create storage directories or query scheduler. Inaccessible directory raises SelectionError rather than empty results.

autoslurm.errors.DiagnosticError.current: RuntimeError subclass; .diagnostic optional; Python cause/traceback remains native. Unknown message without diagnostic stays legacy.
autoslurm.errors.DiagnosticError.effects: Pure; no environment lookup, filesystem access, backend import, command execution or retry.

autoslurm.errors.diagnostic_catalog.current: Detached code/category/summary/action catalogue; no mutable policy leaked.
autoslurm.errors.diagnostic_catalog.effects: Pure; no environment lookup, filesystem access, backend import, command execution or retry.

autoslurm.errors.invalid_argument.inputs: Operation/stage, named field, explanation and optional context.
autoslurm.errors.invalid_argument.current: Known validation Diagnostic; no automatic effect claim.
autoslurm.errors.invalid_argument.effects: Pure; no environment lookup, filesystem access, backend import, command execution or retry.

autoslurm.errors.missing_resource.inputs: Observed absent resource/path; operation/stage, optional cause/effects/context.
autoslurm.errors.missing_resource.current: Diagnostic naming missing resource; callers must not use failed SSH queries as absence.
autoslurm.errors.missing_resource.effects: Pure; no environment lookup, filesystem access, backend import, command execution or retry.

autoslurm.errors.command_failure.inputs: Operation/stage, command name, observed nonzero returncode cause, explicit effects and context.
autoslurm.errors.command_failure.current: command_failed Diagnostic, never inferred scheduler rejection; missing/nonzero evidence ValueError.
autoslurm.errors.command_failure.effects: Pure; no environment lookup, filesystem access, backend import, command execution or retry.

autoslurm.apps.error_output.render_diagn.current: Bounded human string containing primary/secondary context, cause, effects and next action; invalid object TypeError.
autoslurm.apps.error_output.render_diagn.effects: Pure presentation, no printing or recovery.

autoslurm.apps.error_output.exit_with_er.current: Diagnosed DiagnosticError -> text stderr or JSON stdout then SystemExit(1); unknown/legacy/interrupt/debug re-raise original; output failure re-raises initiating error with output issue as context.
autoslurm.apps.error_output.exit_with_er.effects: One terminal/stream write and explicit exit only; no domain action, payload serialization, generic catch hook or retry.

autoslurm.errors.ConfigurationError.inputs: Diagnostic, or inherited DiagnosticError message/optional diagnostic contract.
autoslurm.errors.ConfigurationError.current: Known configuration read/validation exception; DiagnosticError/RuntimeError and ValueError compatibility. .diagnostic holds shared facts; native __cause__ retains originating failure. Replaces old OSError/AttributeError configuration failure family explicitly at this dev release boundary.
autoslurm.errors.ConfigurationError.effects: Pure; no environment lookup, filesystem access, backend import, command execution or retry.

autoslurm.errors.configuration_failure.inputs: Explicit stage, problem=invalid/missing/unreadable/corrupt, optional safe scalar context, cause, summary and caller-supplied effects.
autoslurm.errors.configuration_failure.current: Configuration Diagnostic using existing catalogue codes; no inferred side effects, no raw config. Unknown problem is programming ValueError.
autoslurm.errors.configuration_failure.effects: Pure; no environment lookup, filesystem access, backend import, command execution or retry.

autoslurm.errors.InvalidRequestError.inputs: Known validation message and named field; optional explicit stage/context/DiagnosticCause/effects.
autoslurm.errors.InvalidRequestError.current: DiagnosticError/RuntimeError and ValueError subclass with authoring operation and invalid_argument code. No generic exception classifier. Existing TypeError/KeyError authoring guards and DAG CycleError now use this family; native causes retained.
autoslurm.errors.InvalidRequestError.effects: Pure construction; no I/O, backend imports, printing, exit, retry, repair or inferred effects.

autoslurm.errors.SelectionError.inputs: Known Diagnostic, using inherited DiagnosticError constructor contract.
autoslurm.errors.SelectionError.current: DiagnosticError/RuntimeError and ValueError subclass for expected selector/discovery failures; missing selection replaces FileNotFoundError family. Native filesystem/parser causes remain chained.
autoslurm.errors.SelectionError.effects: Pure construction, no I/O, backend imports, recovery, exit or inferred effects.

autoslurm.errors.selection_failure.inputs: Explicit stage, problem=invalid/missing/unreadable/corrupt and optional safe context/cause/summary.
autoslurm.errors.selection_failure.current: Selection Diagnostic using existing codes/default wording; no effect inference or exception classification. Unknown problem stays programming ValueError.
autoslurm.errors.selection_failure.effects: Pure construction; no lookup, retry, mutation, printing or exit.

autoslurm.errors.RecordWriteError.inputs: Diagnostic or message with diagnostic; raised by known shared publication guards.
autoslurm.errors.RecordWriteError.current: DiagnosticError/RuntimeError/OSError-compatible expected failure; serialization also uses this family, retaining original exception in __cause__.
autoslurm.errors.RecordWriteError.effects: Exception data only; caller supplies exact publication/durability facts. No I/O, retry, rollback or domain outcome inference.

autoslurm.errors.RecordCollisionError.current: RecordWriteError and FileExistsError-compatible; secondary/native cleanup evidence prevents automatic timestamp advancement.
autoslurm.errors.RecordCollisionError.effects: Exception data only; observed collision means this publication did not replace the destination.

autoslurm.errors.record_write_failure.current: Shared Diagnostic using existing storage_failed/invalid_argument codes; unknown problem remains programming ValueError.
autoslurm.errors.record_write_failure.effects: Pure facts construction; never reads files, classifies arbitrary exceptions or infers rollback.

autoslurm.acp._load_action_definitions: Narrow file/JSON failures and expose unavailable metadata; do not silently turn any bug into no actions. MVP10.7/8.
autoslurm.acp.execute_acp: Translate known domain diagnostics without dropping result/receipt; distinguish unexpected bugs and malformed requests. Current catch loses cause/debug details. MVP10.8.
autoslurm.apps.bulk_submit_driver.main: Keep protocol error response and any receipt after dispatch; preserve debug cause separately, include interrupted execution policy. Do not replace helper JSON with terminal rendering. MVP10.5/8.
autoslurm.apps.clean.main: Selecting CANCELLED snapshots: a load failure currently skips an entry without evidence; retain per-file diagnosis and conservative selection. MVP10.7.
Selecting failed snapshots: broad load skip hides corruption/bugs; report retained/skipped entry rather than deleting on unknown. MVP10.7.
autoslurm.bulk_submit_driver.submit_payl: RETAIN evidence-protection catch including KeyboardInterrupt. On persistence failure keep current IDs, phase and original storage cause; don't dispatch another job. MVP10.5.
RETAIN catch including KeyboardInterrupt around sbatch: record rejection versus uncertain acceptance, prior IDs and blocked descendants; persistence error must not erase scheduler cause. MVP10.5.
RETAIN post-acceptance protection: accepted ID remains in memory even if tracking fails; distinguish persistence failure from scheduler failure, keep initiating cause and secondary errors. MVP10.5.
autoslurm.log_files._query_remote_tails: Keep per-reference failed observations on transport/protocol problems, narrow expected catches and retain bounded safe stderr/returncode; unexpected bugs need debug visibility. MVP10.6.
autoslurm.run_slurm.ssh_submission_sessi: RETAIN cleanup protection for owned session; do not exit borrowed connections. Cleanup failures/nonzero close become secondary diagnostics, never overwrite receipt/dispatch error. MVP10.4/5.
autoslurm.scheduler.query_scheduler: Keep batched remote-query failure as unavailable observation, not failed science/missing job; narrow expected parse/transport catches, preserve command/returncode and debug unexpected bugs. MVP10.6.
autoslurm.submission.refresh_submission: RETAIN original receipt/known IDs and report failed observation after remote read/projection; classify known domain versus unexpected errors and handle interrupt boundary deliberately. MVP10.5.
RETAIN secondary tracking-error catch; original refresh cause and receipt cannot be replaced by failure to save the diagnostic. MVP10.5.
autoslurm.submission_operation.execute_p: RETAIN evidence-saving catch including KeyboardInterrupt around staging/dispatch. Preserve operation phase, local receipt and accepted/unknown outcomes, not generic failed submission. MVP10.5.
RETAIN secondary persistence catch including KeyboardInterrupt: keep primary error plus tracking_error; never retry dispatch. MVP10.5.
RETAIN post-dispatch publication catch including KeyboardInterrupt: successful/partial scheduler evidence survives projection failure. MVP10.5.
autoslurm.record_files.atomic_json: RETAIN resource/evidence protection only: store initiating exception while cleanup runs, then re-raise the same native interrupt/programming bug. Known serialization/OSError failures are translated at narrower guards; no broad classification.

RETAIN cleanup protection including interruption/bugs: finish remaining cleanup, retain secondary native failures/diagnostics beside primary, or re-raise original cleanup-only unexpected exception. Never overwrite primary cause or blindly replay publication.

acp:inspect_submission.current: success/result receipt, SubmissionError error/message/result receipt, other load errors message only

Configuration read/JSON/profile/selection validation adopts the shared core; ConfigurationError exported at root and leaf, configuration_failure exported at leaf. CLI aliases/standalone/debug and retained-file regressions added. Authoring/selection/path and publication adoption split into MVP10.3b/c. Historical audit revision remains unchanged.

Authoring adoption and explicit InvalidRequestError dev boundary; command/literal/graph/software-intent/save-preparation guards, shared schedule rendering and native cause preservation. MVP10.3b split before implementation; snapshot selection and path/render slices remain open, as does publication3c.

Snapshot/filter selection adoption, shared per-entry analysis, nullable unknown counts and explicit SelectionError dev boundary. Two broad catches removed; historical reasons retained here. No persisted schema change or universal observation/ACP parity.

Reuses shared InvalidRequestError/SelectionError without new codes/routes/schemas. Bash status2 syntax rejection omits arbitrary stderr literals; other checker failures remain process adoption. No cluster readiness, publication I/O or universal CLI/ACP completion.
